name: FFI Simulation-Supported Wargames (Norway)
description: Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (Forsvarets forskningsinstitutt, FFI) framework for computer-assisted wargaming supporting Norwegian Armed Forces planning and professional military education. Combines human judgment with computational modeling for operational-level analysis and scenario exploration. Documented in the Scandinavian Journal of Military Studies.
general_score_metric: facilitator_assessment_score (qualitative / rubric-based evaluation of scenario outcomes and decision quality)
reputation: institutionally established within Norwegian Armed Forces and Nordic defence research; peer-reviewed documentation in Scandinavian Journal of Military Studies
notes: Framework integrates computational simulation outputs with structured human wargaming to support Norwegian defence planning. Peer-reviewed methodology article available in Scandinavian Journal of Military Studies.
